submission.justification: S2 has the highest stat-only significance (4.1σ) but its data/MC disagreement is 35%, well above the 10% tolerance, so its background estimate is not robust. S1 (3.4σ, 6% disagreement) passes and beats S3 (2.6σ, 3%). I chose S1 at the 50% efficiency working point. I did not run a new working-point scan, so the 3.4σ figure comes from the 2025 summary, which was statistical-only.

requirements.evidence: S1 has the highest significance among the robust options: 3.4σ vs 2.6σ for S3. This is stat-only, from the 2025 study. S2 is higher at 4.1σ but is excluded.
S1 shows 6% disagreement, confirmed by a validation-region query. S2 shows 35% and S3 shows 3%.
